title: ArcCivs0.1.91 any-stage farm care and natural grass: conditional balance
assumptions: Owner explicitly requests care at every immature crop stage and natural dirt-to-grass spread in buildings. Duration, native drops, seed replanting, protection from player extraction of Auto scenery, storage caps and all prices remain unchanged.

One physical farm per participant, normal hunger, no bone meal, dry weather,0.25/1/4 active hours per day. Controlled ZERO-natural-growth case starts crop at age0: before free care only3-to4 cannot complete that next crop; after seven4s cares plus1.5s harvest gives29.5s per complete crop, floored30/122/488 completions. This does NOT claim earlier whole-city income or ordinary natural crop growth was zero.

Natural growth occurs in parallel in the real world, so29.5s is a controlled causal scenario, NOT a global harvest cap. The unchanged harvest-only actor ceiling is2400 actions/hour,1200 at hunger<=6; actual growth, traversal, finite field, seed supply, receipt time, tool wear and storage lower real output. Before/after realized native throughput is unmeasured.

Wheat selected case assumes1WHEAT per native harvest, consistent with the recorded17 native harvests/17WHEAT. Seed surplus sensitivity is1/2/4 per harvest after replant, explicitly hypothetical and NOT a verified loot maximum. Native Fortune/custom tool data and full seed distribution are unmeasured and are not altered. Native carrot/potato output remains unchanged; those are mutually exclusive alternatives to wheat and are not added here. At their known disk SELL2, each actually delivered net item would redeem2Vault; quantity is unmeasured.

Fresh Spawn disk26Oct09:25UTC Farming.yml SHAe973a83f49901e6e6775eaa64f2f98c3f43f8f15f809ff84b8681a602177b804: WHEAT SELL2 and WHEAT_SEEDS SELL0.75, each1280/player with1h restock. Conditional seed/wheat cases are below1280 per active hour. These are disk settings, not in-memory quotes or measured sales. CARROT/POTATO SELL2. Bone meal quote unknown; paid-fertilizer case is excluded, not treated as zero-cost. One real bone meal still buys exactly one age increment at any immature stage.

Auto is an ALTERNATIVE inventory model, not an added physical wheat stream. Free fertilizer alters only protected paid-worksite scenery, exact+1 age, no native item output or XP from care. L1/L2/L3 FOOD remains3/6/9 after60s observed working,120s at hunger<=6, then real depot and unique economic receipt. Existing loose normal-hunger ceilings180/360/540FOOD/hour unchanged; active care may restore realized income toward them. Selected AutoL1 calculation45/180/720FOOD/day assumes consumption permits storage replenishment; capacity is unchanged, not a daily mint reset. One professionXP per ordinary economic receipt is unchanged; care adds no extra XP.

Grass case is a SEPARATE conditional terrain campaign:16/64/256 distinct existing dirt tiles converted per active day, owner collects with SilkTouch and sells instead of selling dirt. Blocks.yml SHA66f548fcc63969a32443e4f9a5e4ab97438d44ac25f623467997a0126946c4e4 disk DIRT1 versus GRASS_BLOCK1.5 gives delta8/32/128Vault on that campaign day. No block quantity is created, no automatic sale occurs, and a plot is not reset every day. Weekly arithmetic requires new distinct dirt inventory each campaign day; it is a sensitivity, not a sustained source or entitlement. Ordinary vanilla natural spread outside buildings already exists. Buy DIRT6 exceeds grass SELL1.5, so this does not introduce a positive shop buy-to-sell loop.

Grass growth remains blocked on exact in-flight world receipt cells and unavailable protected worlds; other environmental/player protections stay. Construction/terraform validation accepts only the natural DIRT-to-GRASS direction, not arbitrary soil or material replacement.

Direct Vault,tokens,playerXP stay separately0. Conditional SELL redemption is indirect mint, separate from item quantities and Auto stock. Current EconomyShopGUI SELL remains current; planned SELL-off/contracts remain future and would remove these shop redemption scenarios. No cap, price, output amount or native loot distribution is introduced by this assessment. User authorized the gameplay relaxation; no silent compensating limit is added.

Multiple assigned farmers can scale care and harvesting until the existing finite field, target claims, bags, food, native growth and building worker slots limit them. The selected calculation is one physical farmer, not a six-worker or network hard cap. Wheat/seed disk shop limits are shared per seller, so multiworker resale cannot multiply those hourly player limits; carrot/potato actual steady-state quantities remain unmeasured. No compensating worker or production cap is added.
